1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.Nc3 c5 4.d5 d6 5.e4 B.strategy: The only recapture: the doubled c-pawns buy the bishop pair and a massive centre. White must use them actively, since the pawns on c3 and c4 are a target.
Attacks the c3 pawn, which nothing defends, with the threat of taking it with check. White must defend or block at once, and Black keeps the initiative against the doubled pawns.
